claims.summary: Closure degree locality: over any field, for the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_j x_ij, multilinear ring) with any number of pigeons and N holes, C_d the degree-d PC closure of all axioms, C_D cap V_d = C_d for d <= D <= ceil(N/2); in particular, for E of degree <= e and K + e <= d, {u in V_K : uE in C_D} = {u in V_K : uE in C_d}, so every kernel question sits at d = K + e. Proof: Proposition 2.8 and Theorem 2.9 (Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall) at d and D, with B_d = B_D restricted to |a| <= d; the functional-transfer entry's degree fact (its case d = K) at a general d.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections (the general form and the hypotheses' Theorem 2.9 at d).
claims.rationale: Reduces every transfer question below half the holes to the window's own top degree.
claims.next_action: Use it to prove conj:linear-kernel-transfer at K=1, D=2.

claims.summary: Conjecture: over F_2, for the functional pigeonhole system with n+1 pigeons and n holes, at D <= ceil(n/2) and K+1 <= D, for every set F of linear errors, the common kernel of F in V_K modulo the degree-D closure C equals the largest, over choices of linear representatives E' = E modulo C cap V_1, of the common kernel modulo the closure H of the hole and functionality axioms, plus C cap V_K. By lem:closure-degree-locality it suffices to take D = K+1. The representative form is needed: x00 + Q_0 has C-kernel 15 but trivial-representative domain side 10 at 6x5. Evidence: check:dense-linear-kernels (one size, K=1).
claims.assessment: Conjecture; restated in the representative form after the sole fresh-context medium reviewer refuted the representative-free draft with x00 + Q_0; evidence one size over F_2.
claims.rationale: Extends transfer to errors no admissible numbering reaches.
claims.next_action: Prove it at K=1, D=2 by the degree-two linear system.

claims.summary: Exact F_2 computation (dense_linear.py with three_quantities.py and tools/pc_closure.py) on the functional pigeonhole system with 6 pigeons and 5 holes at D=3, K=1: for E1 = sum_{j<5} x_jj and E2 = sum_{j<5} x_{j+1,j}, the C-kernel has dimension 7 (the 6 pigeon axioms and (1+E) E = 0, a characteristic-2 killer), equal to the best domain side over all 64 linear representatives, attained by the trivial one; the pair's common C-kernel is the 6 pigeon axioms, equal to the domain side. Controls: x00 15 against 15; the transported-killer instance excess 1; on the polynomial path x00 + Q_0 has C-side 15, trivial representative 10, best representative 15.
claims.assessment: Exact computation; script, numbers and kernel code checked by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer, who asked for the polynomial-path control added in the second run.
claims.rationale: The band review's decisive test; its second outcome occurred.
